title: Brush Collision Free Suggestions
description: Complete puzzle3d brush tool: engagement suggestions and commits must be collision-free. Random compatible order, probe AABB vs scene meshes (exclude host), empty placement when none free.
summary: Fixed false brush collision on tambour stack commit. Collision probes used raw GLB roots without GlbMeshFrame (PI/2 X) while the preview ghost used MeshBody, so AABB probes disagreed with the visible mesh. BrushPreviewGhost also applied kind scale twice (outer pose + MeshBody), inflating the ghost AABB and failing commit/reconcile after a valid suggestion. Added brushPreviewMeshFrameGroup; brushProbeGroupFromPreview now matches scene object mesh graph; removed duplicate scale on ghost MeshBody. Tests: frame rotation, excluded-host stack probe (242 passing).
